title: What final means on a method
answer: A final instance method can be inherited and called normally, but a subclass cannot override it with a new implementation. This is useful when a base class must guarantee behavior or preserve an invariant across all subtypes. AeroTopo declares `Product.id()` final so every Product exposes identity through the same implementation. Overusing final methods can reduce extension flexibility, so the restriction should protect a real design rule.
